title: Untitled (Collaboration with Giulio Rosk)
altText: Stunning collaborative graffiti mural by Mr Blob and Giulio Rosk at Wynwood Mural Fest in Miami, featuring a realistic male portrait underwater and a surreal neon cat character.
description: Painted with Giulio Rosk for the Wynwood Mural Fest in Miami, this collaboration pairs hyperrealistic portraiture with Mr Blob's surreal character design. Against a dark underwater backdrop scattered with bubbles, a realistic male figure gazes toward a haloed, tiger-striped cat creature clutching a glowing vessel, the neon green light binding the two halves of the wall into a single scene.
